trainingDefinition: Repository-backed role, skill, routing, authority, evidence, stop-condition, and covenant contracts. This is not model-weight fine-tuning.
completionCriteria: every required agent has a declared kind
every required agent has a repository skill path that exists
every required agent has explicit default authority
every required agent has explicit capabilities
every required agent has explicit forbidden capabilities
every required agent has a parallel class
every required agent has a communication target
no machine agent may recruit helpers
no machine agent may self approve
Lum is the only conversational boss
provider output is not proof until reconciled
the everlasting covenant guard rail is inherited
all delegated work remains source and scope bound

promotionLaw.ciGreenMeans: training contract is internally consistent for the exact candidate source
